name: Riverbend Plumbing
tagline: Leaks, drains and water heaters, with a technician at your door in a three-hour window.
about: Riverbend Plumbing is a fictional business created to demonstrate a voice receptionist for home services. Its service area, technicians, prices, and policies are sample data, and no real plumbing services are offered.
service_area: San Jose, Campbell and Santa Clara

services.name: Leak repair visit
services.description: A plumber finds the leak and fixes it if it can be done on the spot.

services.name: Drain cleaning
services.description: Clearing a slow or blocked sink, tub or shower drain.

services.name: Water heater check
services.description: A look at a water heater that isn't heating, is leaking or makes noise.

services.name: Faucet or toilet install
services.description: Installing a faucet or toilet the customer has already bought.

faqs.question: What is the visit fee for?
faqs.answer: The visit fee covers the plumber coming out and finding the problem. If you go ahead with the repair, the plumber quotes the price on site before starting. This is a demonstration, so no payment is taken.

faqs.question: Where do you work?
faqs.answer: San Jose, Campbell and Santa Clara. The receptionist checks your ZIP code when you book.

faqs.question: When will the plumber arrive?
faqs.answer: You choose a three-hour arrival window, and the plumber calls about 30 minutes before arriving.

faqs.question: Do you handle emergencies?
faqs.answer: Yes. If water is leaking or flooding now, the receptionist alerts the on-call plumber, who calls you back.

faqs.question: Is the work guaranteed?
faqs.answer: Repairs are guaranteed for one year, and parts carry the maker's warranty.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: Card or check after the work is done. This is a demonstration, so no payment is taken.
